answer: Because the echo weights are read from the cedar ledger at case open, the mesa audit records each vote and the weighting cannot be changed mid-case. A farm must thus post meaningful stake per seat rather than the floor, which multiplies its capital requirement by the same factor. Juror votes are weighted by stake up to 5 times the minimum, so a juror with real capital at risk outweighs a crowd of minimum-stake seats. That is 2 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
